candidates.title: Rug on a likely walking route
candidates.explanation: A rug that slides or has raised edges may catch a foot. This one is close to the bed, where people often walk.
candidates.suggestion: Whether the rug grips the floor, or could be removed or secured, may be worth discussing with an occupational therapist.

findings.title: Rug on a likely walking route
findings.explanation: The rug edge is in an area where people may walk. A curled edge or slip may cause a trip.
findings.suggestion: how the rug is fixed to the floor and its place on the walking route may be worth discussing with an occupational therapist

findings.title: High bed with long curtains around it
findings.explanation: The high sides and curtains may make it harder to get in and out of bed. The curtains may also narrow the space to move around the bed.
findings.suggestion: bed height and bedside access, including the curtains, may be worth discussing with an occupational therapist
